description: A recursive tags witness settles its remaining literals only at its root. An ancestor can supply an inner completion's boundary offer (engine §4.2).
grammar:
%rule text A
%conditions Seen ⊆ $.tags(r)
%rule r :: Seen
 | a
 | q
%rule q r
%rule a $e:empty A
%conditions $e.followed-by(q)
%rule empty ε
